headline: Morning Oche: Coates sinks Nijman on a night of shocks
standfirst: Four top-ten names went on Friday, one of them with a 110.56 average, and the last 32 are up next at Butlins.
body: 1. The headline. Henry Coates, the world number 86, beat Wessel Nijman 6-3 on his debut. Nijman was ranked 10th. Gerwyn Price, Gian van Veen and Ross Smith also went out.
2. The stat. Nijman averaged 110.56 and lost, the best average of the event so far. Coates managed 93.73 and still won, because he barely missed a double.
3. The moment. Sebastian Bialecki beat Price 6-4 after six defeats in six meetings, finishing the match on double seven in 17 darts.
4. The rankings angle. Price is third in the world, Van Veen second, Ross Smith sixth and Nijman tenth. All four are out before Saturday has started.

5. Today. The last 32 run through the afternoon and into the evening, with every match first to six legs. Michael Smith plays Niels Zonneveld, Coates meets Gabriel Clemens and Beau Greaves takes on Rob Owen. Michael van Gerwen faces Darius Labanauskas, Luke Humphries plays Damon Heta, and Jonny Clayton meets Danny Noppert in the last match.
